# IGANI

> IGANI builds the website, the CRM and the AI sales tools behind it, for businesses that sell. Offices in Israel and the United States.

IGANI starts with a website and adds the back end a business needs: a sales back end (CRM with call recording, transcripts and AI call review), a marketing back end (answering every lead and showing what works) and an AI back end (meeting notes, tasks and contracts signed online). Each system runs on the customer's own domain and server.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.igani.co/): what IGANI builds, how it works, the team and how to get in touch
- [Sales back end](https://www.igani.co/sales): CRM with AI call review, so managers see what every rep says
- [Marketing back end](https://www.igani.co/marketing): answer every lead and know what works
- [AI back end](https://www.igani.co/ai): AI notes, tasks and signed contracts
- [All capabilities](https://www.igani.co/build): everything that can be added to a website
- [Don't be a dumb ass](https://www.igani.co/dumb-ass): the campaign page, on calling leads with context and never dropping a follow-up
- [About IGANI](https://www.igani.co/about): the studio and its founders
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.igani.co/faq)
- [Get in touch](https://www.igani.co/#contact): the contact form
